contract.counterfactual: path returns continue after proxy hits only for diagnosis; no-stop returns are not executable
contract.execution: close-to-close approximation: position at row i applies close[i]/close[i-1]
contract.liquidation: episode state starts at the entry prior close; same-side increases use a weighted-average entry and start a new extreme on the increase bar; reductions preserve entry/extreme; flat or reversal resets; each active bar then checks that causal episode state against the day's high/low with fixed leverage and 0.02 reserve

local_pbo_dsr.reason: the 40 trials are a leverage frontier diagnostic, not an independent source-strategy search

contract.return_accounting: compounded close-to-close account-equity proxy via cumulative product of per-bar returns; not fixed-notional PnL
contract.selected_strategy_fail_closed_reason: validation stress MDD exceeds the predeclared 25% paper gate; locked-test stress MDD is below 25% but positive blocks are only 2, so the selected strategy remains fail closed
contract.selection_development_scope: eligible only when the full train+validation development path has zero market-OHLC proxy hits; locked test is never used for selection
contract.tp_sl: none; this is the existing signal's exit behavior

selection.criterion: maximum validation stress compounded close-to-close account-equity proxy net return among rows with zero market-OHLC-proxy hits across full train+validation development path
